comment: IANA's media type registrations for the three file formats the device source reads by a registered file extension: application/mbox (RFC 4155), text/calendar (RFC 5545) and text/vcard (RFC 6350), each byte for byte as IANA publishes it. Each registration states its file extensions. app/src/PrismDevice.lex.tex quotes that statement for every extension it names, and generators/browser's deviceformats refuses an extension whose quoted statement is not in its pinned registration (GN-01); generators/snapshot's lockcheck holds each file to its SHA-256.
